title: Integrated metabolomic and single-cell analyses reveal crotonylation-related epithelial remodeling and SDC4 dysregulation in adenomyosis.
authors: Wang, Jiaxi; Li, Yue; Zhang, Hongyu; Zhao, Yiling; Fan, Wei; Xin, Wenhu; Qiang, Chunhua; Qin, Tiansheng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究子宫腺肌症中巴豆酰化相关上皮重塑与SDC4失调，仅用转录因子预测等计算分析，不涉及蛋白质-DNA结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Adenomyosis (AM) is characterized by ectopic endometrial invasion and myometrial fibrosis, yet the molecular links between local metabolic remodeling, lysine crotonylation (Kcr), and epithelial dysfunction remain poorly understood. We investigated the metabolic and crotonylation-related landscape of AM and sought to identify epithelial molecular features associated with these alterations. METHODS: Clinical metabolic profiles, public and newly generated tissue metabolomic data, crotonyl-CoA measurements, and tissue crotonylation assays were integrated with single-cell and bulk transcriptomic analyses. Kcr-related transcriptional patterns were characterized using multiple gene-set scoring approaches and co-expression analysis, followed by multi-algorithm feature prioritization. SDC4-associated epithelial states were further examined using trajectory inference, cell-cell communication analysis, transcription-factor prediction, and in silico perturbation. RESULTS: Adjusted clinical analyses showed no robust differences in circulating lipid profiles, whereas tissue-level metabolomic analyses revealed alterations in lipid- and lysine-related metabolites in AM. Crotonyl-CoA estimates were higher in AM tissue, accompanied by increased H3K18cr. A higher p65-associated Kcr signal was also observed in a single IP comparison; given that only one IP measurement was available per group, this finding should be considered a preliminary descriptive observation. Single-cell analyses identified prominent Kcr-related transcriptional patterns in epithelial cells and linked this state to adhesion, junctional organization, and epithelial remodeling. SDC4 was consistently prioritized across five machine-learning procedures and was predominantly expressed in epithelial populations. SDC4-positive epithelial cells exhibited distinct inferred differentiation states and intercellular communication patterns, while computational perturbation further implicated SDC4-associated networks in epithelial adhesion, cytoskeletal organization, and junctional regulation. CONCLUSION: These findings connect local metabolic remodeling and crotonylation-related alterations with a distinct epithelial transcriptional state in AM and identify SDC4 as a consistently prioritized candidate associated with epithelial remodeling. The preliminary p65-associated Kcr observation provides additional context for investigating potential associations among Kcr, p65, and SDC4-related epithelial programs.
abstract_zh: 背景：子宫腺肌症（adenomyosis, AM）以异位子宫内膜侵袭和子宫肌层纤维化为特征，但局部代谢重塑、赖氨酸巴豆酰化（lysine crotonylation, Kcr）与上皮功能障碍之间的分子联系仍知之甚少。我们研究了AM的代谢和巴豆酰化相关图谱，并试图鉴定与这些改变相关的上皮分子特征。方法：将临床代谢谱、公开及新生成的组织代谢组学数据、巴豆酰辅酶A（crotonyl-CoA）测量和组织巴豆酰化检测与单细胞及批量转录组分析进行整合。使用多种基因集评分方法和共表达分析表征Kcr相关转录模式，随后进行多算法特征优先级排序。进一步使用轨迹推断、细胞间通讯分析、转录因子预测和计算机模拟扰动来检验SDC4相关上皮状态。结果：校正后的临床分析显示循环脂质谱无稳健差异，而组织水平代谢组学分析揭示了AM中脂质和赖氨酸相关代谢物的改变。AM组织中巴豆酰辅酶A估计值较高，并伴有H3K18cr升高。在单次IP比较中也观察到较高的p65相关Kcr信号；鉴于每组仅有一次IP测量，该发现应视为初步描述性观察。单细胞分析在上皮细胞中鉴定出显著的Kcr相关转录模式，并将该状态与黏附、连接组织和上皮重塑相关联。SDC4在五种机器学习流程中均被一致优先排序，且主要在上皮细胞群中表达。SDC4阳性上皮细胞表现出不同的推断分化状态和细胞间通讯模式，而计算扰动进一步提示SDC4相关网络参与上皮黏附、细胞骨架组织和连接调控。结论：这些发现将局部代谢重塑和巴豆酰化相关改变与AM中一种独特的上皮转录状态联系起来，并确定SDC4为与上皮重塑相关的、被一致优先排序的候选分子。初步的p65相关Kcr观察为研究Kcr、p65和SDC4相关上皮程序之间的潜在关联提供了额外背景。
